content:
Hi everyone, requesting feedback on a small PR #40442, whose main results are that the set of points on the same/opposite side of a point p are convex.

I'm taking a crack at Sperner's lemma (issue #25231), and have some idea of the main geometric components needed. This is the very first part of that, and I wanted to make sure I'm not egregiously violating Mathlib standards/conventions before I go much further on the rest.

Thank you!
